contact_name.value: John Williams, B.S. (with Master's courses) Laboratory Director & Analyst

services.value: Aquatec Environmental offers environmental freshwater and marine effluent and sediment testing services, including aquatic toxicity testing (effluent/soil & sediment) following US EPA protocols, and soil & sediment toxicity testing following US EPA, ASTM, and US ACE protocols. It also provides freshwater fish surveys (electrofishing) and biological tissue homogenization/organism preparations supporting the Great Lakes Fish Monitoring & Surveillance Program (GLFMSP).
